Question: How much should I trust Elon Musk on robotaxi timelines?



## Elon Musk (elon-musk)
Track record, all topics: 21 predictions on record: 4 correct, 9 incorrect, 0 partial, 0 unresolvable, 8

data.answer: Give Musk’s robotaxi timelines low weight: on this topic he is 2 correct out of 6 graded predictions, with 6 still pending, 33% accuracy, a 0.43 Brier score versus 0.25 for a coin flip, and late successes taking 2.4x as long as promised. The misses include 2016-10-19: “by the end of next year” for a no-touch LA-to-New York autonomy demo, 2019-04-22: “we'll have over a million robotaxis on the road” by 2020, 2025-01-29: “unsupervised, no one in the car” in Austin in June 2025, and 2025-07-23: “half the population of the US” by end-2025. The positive cases are narrower/reframed: 2025-05-20: “looking good for Austin next month” and 2025-06-11: “First Tesla that drives itself” to a customer house. Uncertainty: 12 robotaxi predictions are recorded; 6 are pending/not yet due and none are unresolvable.
